description: This file contains implementation of indirect register access APIs for Realtek RTL826XB PHY hardware, including functions for reading and writing to hardware registers via indirect methods.

methods.name: int rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_read(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 page,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Performs an indirect read from PHY register via specified page and register addresses, with bit masking and retries.

methods.name: int rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_write(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 page,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 data)
methods.description: Performs an indirect write to PHY register via specified page and register addresses, with bit masking.
